recipes.oracle_text:
Enchant permanent
When this Aura enters, you gain 4 life.
Enchanted permanent can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.

recipe_coverage: Reviewed signed-stat and restriction Aura components: surviving large and lethal small creatures, normal casting/target loss, cleanup persistence, legal Disenchant removal/Disperse bounce, host loss, owner-specific populated zones, exact costs, snapshot/AI replay, real attacking/blocking, and restricted nonmana/mana activations with an unaffected control. Printed entry life, Aura-to-hand death replacement, and combat damage prevention are checked where declared. This is component coverage, not whole-card certification. Other activated abilities, threshold, upkeep/end-step triggers, target-triggered self-removal, transformations, Vehicle interactions, retargeting, and color/subtype changes remain separate gaps where present; Kirtar's Desire uses four graveyard cards, below threshold. Arachnus Web cleanup uses a 2-power host, below its end-step threshold; its large-target case does not advance to the end step.
